# Product flow files — one JSON per family (generated by agents from route-flow.json; reviewed by humans)

Each `<family>.json` is an array of products:

```jsonc
{
  "product": "Marketing",                 // tile name in products.ts
  "family": "Business",
  "summary": "≤2 plain sentences: what a person does here",
  "entry": "/marketing",                  // where the tile lands
  "sections": [                           // the product sidebar, in order
    { "name": "Websites", "route": "/marketing/[brandId]/websites", "why": "…",
      "pages": [ { "route": "/marketing/[brandId]/websites/crawls", "title": "Crawls",
                   "role": "list|record|create|tool|settings|report|redirect|legacy|placeholder",
                   "reachedFrom": ["/marketing/[brandId]/websites"], "leadsTo": ["…"] } ] }
  ],
  "journeys": [ { "name": "Audit a client's website", "steps": ["/marketing/brands", "/marketing/[brandId]", "…"] } ],
  "stranded": [ { "route": "…", "why": "no menu or link reaches it", "proposedHome": "Section name" } ],
  "buried":   [ { "route": "…", "depth": 3, "why": "critical but N clicks deep", "proposal": "…" } ],
  "missingFromTree": [ { "name": "Websites", "route": "…", "why": "…" } ],
  "legacy":   [ { "route": "…", "kind": "redirect|old copy|bake-off", "note": "…" } ],
  "duplicates": [ { "routes": ["…","…"], "note": "…" } ]
}
```
Every route in the family's part of route-homes.tsv must appear exactly once across sections/stranded/legacy.
